meta.title: tristar-2006 conversation antarctica
meta.author: Quickyman
meta.description: tristar-2006 conversation antarctica by Quickyman, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 5) taken from the V2M collection of jgilje/v2m-player (`v2m/Quickyman--tristar-2006_conversation_antarctica.v2mz`; its README points to modland). 120 BPM, 3:50, 17 tracks. The V2 file's last tick is at 6:36; the song here ends 4 s after the last note (a note held more than 16 s past the last note-on is cut there). This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
